use crate::io::Read;
use crate::sync::OnceLock;

static SCHEME: OnceLock<File> = OnceLock::new();

pub fn fill_bytes(bytes: &mut [u8]) {

        .and_then(|mut scheme| scheme.read_exact(bytes))
